## 📜 Checklist

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `AGENTS.md`.
- [ ] The change is focused and follows the commit conventions.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated and pass locally.

- [ ] Documentation was updated when commands, dependencies, or behavior changed.
- [ ] The contribution can be licensed under AGPL-3.0-only and contains no closed-source or proprietary code.
- [ ] I removed secrets, credentials, and personal data from logs and screenshots.
